text:
sam: opened PR #5567 to clarify Console observability migration steps and add a tiny examples bundle (jq/sed, PromQL, tracing-hook normalization). https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5567

arpita: Skimmed. The jq snippet is great. Small ask: add a backup step and a note to null `id` fields before Grafana import.

jon: Also flag SDK snippets: older SDKs (v0.9.x) use a different client constructor. Add a quick compat note so customers don't copy-paste and get runtime errors.

sam: Good call. I'll add a short compatibility paragraph.

arpita: Tracing note: some runtimes prefix trace IDs with `0x`. Suggest showing normalization in Python and Node rather than assuming format.

sam: draft examples I'll add:```python
# normalize trace id (Python)
trace_id = trace.id.hex()
if trace_id.startswith('0x'):
    trace_id = trace_id[2:]
```
```js
// normalize trace id (Node)
const traceId = (trace.id || '').replace(/^0x/, '');
```

jon: Perfect. Also add a line: "If traces are sampled out, trace-linked panels may underreport attributed cost; use metric rollups for billing checks."

arpita: For dashboard remap, suggest both sed and jq examples. Sed for single-file quickfix, jq for nested targets. Eg:```bash
# sed (BSD-compatible alternative shown)
cp -n exported exported-backup || true
perl -pi.bak -e "s/console.cost_per_token/console_unit_cost_total/g" exported/*.json
```
```bash
# jq (nested targets)
for f in exported/*.json; do
  jq '(.panels[]?.targets[]?.expr) |= gsub("console.cost_per_token"; "console_unit_cost_total")' "$f" > tmp && mv tmp "$f"
done
```

sam: added both and a short note about removing panel `id` to avoid conflicts: `jq '(.panels[]?.id) = null'`.

assets-bot: uploaded 2 files to /assets/images/docs/observability/remap-before.png and /assets/images/docs/observability/remap-after.png

ux: UX quick note: please include alt text and add a 1px contrast border to screenshots for accessibility.

sam: uploaded alt text and added border. Also included a PromQL rollup example:```promql
sum(increase(console_unit_cost_total[1h])) by (service)
```

jon: Add a per-request cost example: divide by `sum(increase(request_count_total[1h])) by (service)` in Grafana transform.

arpita: doc-bot lint: code fence language for PromQL should be `promql`. Also linkchecker found one broken repo link to `assets/oldpath`.

sam: fixed fence language and corrected the link. Pushed new commit.

doc-bot: Re-running checks... linkcheck OK. Spelling: 0 warnings. CI: green.

jon: Staging preview scheduled. Who merges?

sam: I'll merge after staging looks good. Thanks for the quick reviews :tada:

release-bot: Staging deploy queued for branch docs/5567 — ETA ~6m.

release-bot: Staging deploy complete. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/console/observability-migration

sam: Looks good on staging, panels render and smoke query returns expected values. Merging now.

arpita: Thanks! Leaving a follow-up issue to track adding an automated example test for the jq remap in CI.

sam: Filed ISSUE #1103. Closing PR after merge. :rocket:
